_comment: What the registry said when 📝 Doc Generator last read it. Evidence, not configuration — scripts/generate-docs.mjs refuses to publish a page for any component that is not Completed here, and refuses again if the component's own directory has a commit newer than readAt, because the status recorded here would then predate the change. Regenerate it by running the doc-generator agent, which has the Airtable connection; a build script deliberately does not. Names and statuses only: no base, table, or record IDs. This file is tracked and the repo is public.
